artworks.title: Nicolas Abraham de la Framboisiere
artworks.description: The image portrays a man in historical attire with distinctive facial features, seated and facing slightly to the left. He has an aged appearance, with short wavy hair, a full beard, and a prominent forehead. The man wears a garment with a high, wide collar and a detailed vest or jacket. In the upper left, there is a framed shield design and below the portrait, an ornate inscription plaque. The background is a textured surface that resembles an engraved print.

artworks.title: Francis II, King of France
artworks.artist: Thomas de Leu after François Clouet
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person from the shoulders up, set within an oval frame. The person is positioned facing forward, with their head slightly turned to the right. The individual has youthful facial features, characterized by soft contours, large eyes, and a neutral expression. Their hair is covered by an elaborate hat with a feather and decorative elements. The clothing is ornate, including a high collar with fur trim and a richly embellished garment. There is no visible jewelry. The background within the oval frame is textured with lines, creating a sense of depth. Surrounding the portrait is text identifying the subject as "FRANCOIS SECOND ROY DE FRANCE," with additional text in French at the bottom.

artworks.title: Francis II, King of France
artworks.description: The image displays a full-length figure of a person standing with one leg raised on a step. The individual is positioned dynamically with an open stance, as one foot is planted on the ground while the other rests on the step, bent at the knee. The person's head is adorned with a voluminous, textured headpiece or hair that curls and frames their face. The facial features are finely etched, showing defined eyes, a prominent nose, and pursed lips. Their clothing consists of a draped garment that covers the body loosely, with one arm partially visible. The fabric folds elegantly, creating a sense of movement. The background is a plain surface, with subtle lines suggesting depth, and there are shadows present that emphasize the figure's form. The image is a detailed engraving, capturing intricate lines and textures.

artworks.title: Franciscus Guilielmus
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's upper body facing slightly left. He has distinct facial features, wavy hair, and wears a skullcap. The man is dressed in a richly decorated garment with a large collar and buttons. The background features a large circular frame with radiating lines.

artworks.title: Frederick I, Duke of Wurtemberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright. He has a beard, mustache, and short, curly hair. He is wearing an ornate coat, ruffled collar, cuffs, stockings, and elaborate footwear. He has an ornate chain around his neck and holds a staff in his right hand. The background includes draped fabric, a classical pillar, and a section of cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Fredericus IIII (Frederick IV)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarter view portrait. He has a full beard, mustache, and shoulder-length wavy hair. The man is dressed in 16th or 17th-century attire, with a high-collared shirt, lace ruffle, and patterned doublet. The background features an oval frame with etched text.

artworks.title: Frederick IV, Elector Palatine
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait. He is positioned slightly to the side but facing the viewer. The man has a notable nose, strong cheekbones, a groomed mustache, and neat hair. He wears noble clothing with intricate embroidery, a fur-lined cloak, and a sash across his chest. The portrait is framed with classical decorations including a lion crest, shields, figures, and foliage. The inscription below identifies him as "Friedrich IV, Elector Palatine."

artworks.title: Frederick IV, Elector Palatine
artworks.description: The image displays the upper torso of a man facing slightly left. He has a long, pointed beard and mustache, expressive eyes, curly shoulder-length hair, and a solemn expression. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, a detailed coat with a high collar, lace, trim, and buttons. A structured garment or cloak is draped over his shoulders. The background features textured patterns within an oval frame containing inscriptions and lettering, with additional intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Frederick IV
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing with his torso slightly turned and his legs apart. His face is forward with a composed expression, and he has prominent facial features including a high forehead. He wears a hat with a feather, and his hair is not distinctly visible. The man is dressed in elaborate clothing featuring an ornately patterned coat with a large collar, a detailed doublet, and hose. He is holding a small bunch of plants in one hand and wears a necklace. Beside him is a lion, lying down with its head up. The background includes a tiled floor, a coat of arms in the upper right corner, and text surrounding the figure, with a decorative border enclosing the entire scene.

artworks.title: Frederick V, Count Palatine
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest upwards, facing forward and slightly turned to their left. The individual has distinct facial features including a broad forehead, arched eyebrows, and deep-set eyes with a focused gaze. Their hair is styled in voluminous waves. They are wearing richly textured, ornate attire with detailed patterns, an elaborate ruffled collar, and decorative embellishments. The attire includes motifs of foliage or floral design and a pendant hangs from their neck. The background features a decorative arch with elegant patterns.

artworks.title: Frederick of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man looking directly at the viewer. He has curly, shoulder-length hair and a well-groomed goatee and mustache. The man wears elaborate attire typical of nobility, including a richly embroidered jacket and a large lace collar. The background features a textured oval frame with Latin text. At the bottom, there is an inscription with additional text, likely identifying the subject and artist.

artworks.title: Frederick, King of Bohemia
artworks.description: The man is seated on a horse in a rearing position. He is visible from head to waist, with a voluminous ruffed collar around his neck and long, wavy hair. He wears ornate armor and holds the reins of the horse, which is also adorned with decorative elements. The background shows a cityscape and a hillside. Two ornate crests are in the upper corners of the image.

artworks.title: Fredericus D.G. Bohem. Rex (Frederick V, Kingof Bohemia)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a seated person, slightly angled to one side. The person has distinct facial features, short curly hair, and wears a crown. They are dressed in elaborate early modern attire with a cloak, collar, sash, and pendant. The person holds a sword and rests their hand on a helmet. The backdrop includes heavy drapes, garlands, and scrollwork with inscriptions. The composition is encased in an ornate border.

artworks.title: Frederick VI, Duke of Wurtenberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial procession and banquet. The image shows a detailed illustration of a formal and ritualistic scene featuring robed figures in a procession leading to a grand interior space. The drawing includes architectural structures, decorative emblems, and a significant gathering around an elevated altar. On the right side, an open-floor hall is depicted with banquet tables filled with guests and attendants. The scene hints at a historical or significant social event, possibly set in Europe during medieval times.

artworks.title: Frederick Achilles, Duke of Wurtenburg
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up, facing forward. The man has a stern expression, rounded facial features, prominent cheekbones, and a small chin. His hair is voluminous and curly, framing his face symmetrically. He is wearing a high-collared, quilted garment. Two cherubs are depicted on each side of the oval frame enclosing the portrait, with one holding a shield and the other holding a harp. The background has a richly decorated border with intricate scrollwork, and inscriptions are present above and below the oval. The image has a luxurious, classical style consistent with the artistic methods of the period depicted.

artworks.title: Frederick Christian III, King of Denmark and Norway
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in a slightly turned position, facing the viewer. The person has delicate facial features, a small mustache, and curly hair. They wear an ornate outfit with a detailed high collar and lace details. The person appears to be holding an object, possibly a sword, by the hilt with their right hand. The background has a textured, cross-hatched pattern. Below the portrait is a text inscription with the name 'Frederick Christiaen' and additional information.

artworks.title: Prince Frederick Henry
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a young boy standing upright and facing forward. His facial features are youthful with a smooth complexion and his hair is styled in a voluminous, curly fashion. He is dressed in an elaborate outfit characteristic of a high-status individual, featuring intricate lace patterns and embellishments. His attire includes a high, ornate lace collar, a jacket with detailed embroidery, and a long skirt. He is holding a racket-like object delicately in one hand, resting on what appears to be a surface or table. The background is simple and unadorned, with minimal line work, focusing the attention on the figure in the foreground.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry of Nassau
artworks.description: The image shows a man in detailed armor, with a cape, holding a baton in his right hand and his left hand on the hilt of a sword. The man has a mustache and a small pointed beard, with curly hair. He stands in front of a fabric backdrop and a table with a plumed helmet and military standards or swords.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry of Nassau
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a man with curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee, wearing a dark outfit with a lace collar and shoulder details. The man is seated, turned slightly to his left, with his head facing forward. The backdrop is composed of fine lines within an oval frame, which contains text around its inner edge.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry of Nassau
artworks.description: The image contains an upper-body portrait of a man facing slightly to the right. He has facial hair, including a mustache and a small goatee, and curly, medium-length hair. The man wears formal attire, consisting of a high-collared shirt with an intricate lace collar and a dark garment fastened with buttons. He also wears a medal or pendant around his neck. The background has an engraved texture, and the oval frame includes engraved text at the top and bottom. The surroundings outside the oval are plain.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry of Nassau
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body portrait of a man. He is slightly turned to his right but facing the viewer. The man has curly, medium-length hair and a mustache with a small goatee. His expression is neutral, with a direct gaze. He is wearing a formal outfit with a high lace collar and elaborate clothing. A medallion on a chain is around his neck. The background features a crosshatched surface enclosed by an ornate oval frame with inscriptions and gothic text.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry of Nassau
artworks.artist: Jacob van Meurs after Gerrit van Honthorst
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of a person with wavy shoulder-length hair, an elaborate mustache, and a small goatee. They wear formal attire with a detailed lace collar and a dark garment with decorative elements and a tassel on the neck. In the background, there is an oval frame with text at the top saying "PATRIAQUE PATRIOQVE" and at the bottom "FREDERICUS HENRICUS A NASSAV PRINCEPS ARAVSIONVM."

artworks.title: Frederick Henry of Nassau
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing slightly to the right. They have distinct facial features such as a beard and mustache, styled voluminous hair with waves, and wear formal attire with a high ruffled collar, armor, and a draped cloak. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame against a light-colored background. There are inscriptions identifying the person within a textured rectangular border surrounding the portrait.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing confidently with one foot on a pedestal, holding a sword in his right hand and resting his left hand on his hip. He has a mustache and short curly hair, and wears an elaborate suit of armor with a large ruff collar around his neck. The armor is adorned with ornate patterns and a sash across the chest. Beside him, a sculptured pedestal supports a helmet with a feathered crest. Shields with coats of arms are displayed on a stand beside him. The background features intricate buildings and people in motion, along with a partly cloudy sky with birds.
